```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 5.5
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(rstudioapi)
  library(R.matlab)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)

codepath <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)
project_root <- dirname(dirname(codepath))
datapath <- file.path(project_root, "data")
vispath <- file.path(project_root, "vis")
modelpath <- file.path(datapath, "models")

outpath <- file.path(datapath, "results_markdown", "part4_ica_vs_full15cca")
figpath <- file.path(vispath, "results", "part4_ica_vs_full15cca")
dir.create(outpath, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figpath, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(codepath, "data_loading_functions.R"))
if (file.exists(file.path(codepath, "ecg_annotations.R"))) {

fig_font_family <- "Times New Roman"

method_cols <- c(
  "ICA" = "#1D4E89",
  "CCA" = "#8A1538"
)

heat_cols <- c(
  "#EFEFEF",
  "#F6D96B",
  "#E07A3F",

)

)

status_cols <- c(

)

theme_pub <- theme_bw(base_size = 12, base_family = fig_font_family) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F3EFE7", colour = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),

scale_fill_heat <- function(..., limits = NULL, labels = waiver(), breaks = waiver()) {
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = heat_cols,
    limits = limits,
    labels = labels,
    breaks = breaks,
    oob = scales::squish,
    ...
  )
}

safe_q <- function(x, p) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  unname(stats::quantile(x, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE))
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x)
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  median(x)
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}

fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%"))
}

public_table_names <- function(x) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x)) return(x)
  nm <- names(x)
  nm <- stringr::str_replace_all(nm, "parent_n_ecg_leads", "parent_n_ecg_channels")
  nm <- stringr::str_replace_all(nm, "n_ecg_leads", "n_ecg_channels")
  nm <- stringr::str_replace_all(nm, "ecg_leads", "ecg_channels")
  names(x) <- nm
  x
}

kable_clean <- function(x, digits = 2, ...) {
  knitr::kable(public_table_names(x), digits = digits, ...)
}

save_table <- function(x, name, csv = TRUE) {
  rds_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(x, rds_file)
  csv_file <- NA_character_
  if (csv) {
    csv_file <- file.path(outpath, paste0(name, ".csv"))
    utils::write.csv(public_table_names(x), csv_file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(tibble(name = name, rds = rds_file, csv = csv_file, n_rows = nrow(x)))
}

save_plot <- function(plot, name, width = 9, height = 5.5) {
  if (!isTRUE(params$save_figures)) return(invisible(plot))
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(figpath, paste0(name, ".png")), plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  invisible(plot)
}

make_combo_uid <- function(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads) {
  paste(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, sep = "__")
}

parse_leads <- function(x) {
  as.integer(strsplit(as.character(x), ",")[[1]])
}

make_subset_strings <- function(ecg_leads, subset_size = 1) {
  leads <- sort(unique(parse_leads(ecg_leads)))
  if (length(leads) < subset_size) return(character())
  combn(leads, subset_size, FUN = function(z) paste(z, collapse = ","), simplify = TRUE)
}

label_subset <- function(subset_string, lookup = NULL) {
  if (is.null(lookup) || !"ecg_lead" %in% names(lookup)) {
    return(subset_string)
  }
  leads <- parse_leads(subset_string)
  if (!"lead_label" %in% names(lookup)) return(subset_string)
  labels <- lookup$lead_label[match(leads, lookup$ecg_lead)]
  paste(labels, collapse = ", ")
}

n_top_prop <- function(n, prop = params$top_prop) {
  max(1L, ceiling(prop * n))
}

standardise_exact_summary_names <- function(x) {
  # Accept either the newer names from part 3 or older names from previous scripts.
  nm <- names(x)
  if ("delta_vs_full15_sesoi_units" %in% nm && !"loss_sesoi_units" %in% nm) {
    x <- x %>% rename(loss_sesoi_units = delta_vs_full15_sesoi_units)
  }
  if ("median_delta_sesoi_units" %in% nm && !"median_loss_sesoi_units" %in% nm) {
    x <- x %>% rename(median_loss_sesoi_units = median_delta_sesoi_units)
  }
  if ("median_q90_delta_sesoi_units" %in% nm && !"median_q90_loss_sesoi_units" %in% nm) {
    x <- x %>% rename(median_q90_loss_sesoi_units = median_q90_delta_sesoi_units)
  }
  if ("delta_vs_full15_pct_baseline" %in% nm && !"loss_pct_baseline" %in% nm) {
    x <- x %>% rename(loss_pct_baseline = delta_vs_full15_pct_baseline)
  }
  x
}

rank_exact_summary <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    arrange(
      n_ecg_leads,
      desc(median_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(mean_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(q25_pct_channels_as_well),
      desc(n_participants_ge50_channels),
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units,
      median_loss_sesoi_units,
      ecg_leads
    ) %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
    mutate(rank_within_n = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()
}

manifest <- list()
```

# Overview

This supplementary/control analysis evaluates ICA reduced ECG-channel combinations against the same reference used in the main reduced-channel CCA analysis: the best full 15-channel CCA result per participant × EEG channel. The analysis therefore asks whether reduced-channel ICA combinations can approximate the full 15-channel CCA benchmark.

The file has two parts:

1. **4A:** ICA-only reduced ECG-channel combinations versus full 15-channel CCA, including exact-combination ranking, robustness, within-SESOI top-20% stability, recurring subsets, and anatomical families.
2. **4B:** Direct comparison of ICA and CCA reduced ECG-channel summaries using the Part 3 CCA outputs when available.

# 4A. ICA combinations versus full 15-channel CCA

## Load channel labels and define file plans

```{r data-plan}
sesoi_prop <- params$sesoi_prop

chlabels_data1 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels.mat")
chlabels_data2 <- load_chlabels_dataset("sub_chlabels_data2.mat")

n_data1 <- length(chlabels_data1)
n_data2 <- length(chlabels_data2)
participant_levels <- sprintf("P%02d", seq_len(n_data1 + n_data2))

file_plan_data1 <- tribble(
  ~n_ecg_leads, ~file,
  1L, "combinationsdata_1_2_3.mat",
  2L, "combinationsdata_1_2_3.mat",
  3L, "combinationsdata_1_2_3.mat",
  4L, "combinationsdata_4.mat",
  5L, "combinationsdata_5.mat"
)

file_plan_data2 <- tibble(
  n_ecg_leads = 1:5,
  file = sprintf("combinationsdata2_%d.mat", n_ecg_leads)
)

all_channel_counts <- c(
  map_int(chlabels_data1, length),
  map_int(chlabels_data2, length)
)

analysis_accounting <- tibble(
  n_participants = n_data1 + n_data2,
  n_participant_channel_cells = sum(all_channel_counts),
  median_channels_per_participant = median(all_channel_counts),
  min_channels_per_participant = min(all_channel_counts),
  max_channels_per_participant = max(all_channel_counts)
)

kable_clean(analysis_accounting)
manifest[["01_analysis_accounting"]] <- save_table(analysis_accounting, "01_analysis_accounting")
```

## Full 15-channel CCA reference

```{r full15-cca-reference}
load_full15_cca_reference <- function() {
  df_cca_rpeak_data1 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data1,
    dataset = "data1",
    offset = 0,
    methods = "CCA",
    measure = "rpeak"
  )
  
  df_cca_rpeak_data2 <- load_full15_rpeak_dataset(
    data_file = "data4stats_2.mat",
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data2,
    dataset = "data2",
    offset = n_data1,
    methods = "CCA",
    measure = "rpeak"
  )
  
  bind_rows(df_cca_rpeak_data1, df_cca_rpeak_data2) %>%
    mutate(
      participant = factor(participant, levels = participant_levels),
      participant = as.character(participant),
      dataset = as.character(dataset),
      channel = as.character(channel),
      clean = as.integer(clean)
    ) %>%
    group_by(dataset, participant, channel) %>%
    summarise(
      rpeak_full15cca_clean1 = mean(rpeak[clean == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
      rpeak_full15cca_best = min(rpeak, na.rm = TRUE),
      clean_full15cca_best = clean[which.min(rpeak)][1],
      sesoi_subj_channel = sesoi_prop * abs(rpeak_full15cca_clean1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(rpeak_full15cca_clean1),
      is.finite(rpeak_full15cca_best),
      is.finite(sesoi_subj_channel),
      sesoi_subj_channel > 0
    )
}

full15cca_ref_file <- file.path(outpath, "02_full15cca_reference.rds")

if (file.exists(full15cca_ref_file)) {
  full15cca_ref <- readRDS(full15cca_ref_file)
} else {
  full15cca_ref <- load_full15_cca_reference()
  saveRDS(full15cca_ref, full15cca_ref_file)
}

full15cca_ref %>%
  summarise(
    n_participant_channel_cells = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
    median_baseline_rpeak = median(rpeak_full15cca_clean1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_full15cca_best = median(rpeak_full15cca_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sesoi = median(sesoi_subj_channel, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

manifest[["02_full15cca_reference"]] <- save_table(full15cca_ref, "02_full15cca_reference", csv = FALSE)
```

## Load ICA combinations only and score against full 15-channel CCA

```{r load-score-ica-combinations}
load_ica_combination_best_one_dataset <- function(
    file_plan,
    chlabels_by_group,
    dataset_name,
    offset
) {
  split(file_plan, file_plan$file) %>%
    imap_dfr(function(this_plan, file_name) {
      message("Loading ", dataset_name, " / ", file_name, " for ICA only")
      comb <- readMat(file.path(datapath, file_name))
      
      out <- map_dfr(this_plan$n_ecg_leads, function(k) {
        message("  n ECG channels = ", k)
        
        df_k <- load_comb_rpeak_methods(
          comb = comb,
          n_leads = k,
          methods = "ICA",
          chlabels_by_group = chlabels_by_group
        ) %>%
          filter(method == "ICA") %>%
          mutate(
            participant_local = as.integer(as.character(participant)),
            participant = format_pid(participant_local, offset),
            dataset = dataset_name,
            channel = as.character(channel),
            n_ecg_leads = as.integer(n_ecg_leads),
            combination_id = as.integer(combination_id),
            ecg_leads = as.character(ecg_leads),
            clean = as.integer(clean)
          )
        
        best_k <- df_k %>%
          group_by(
            dataset,
            participant,
            participant_local,
            n_ecg_leads,
            channel,
            combination_id,
            ecg_leads
          ) %>%
          summarise(
            best_i = which.min(rpeak)[1],
            rpeak_ica_reduced_best = rpeak[best_i],
            clean_ica_reduced_best = clean[best_i],
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          select(-best_i)
        
        rm(df_k)
        gc()
        best_k
      })
      
      rm(comb)
      gc()
      out
    })
}

ica_scored_file <- file.path(outpath, "03_ica_comb_vs_full15cca_scored.rds")

if (file.exists(ica_scored_file)) {
  ica_comb_vs_full15cca <- readRDS(ica_scored_file)
} else {
  ica_comb_best_data1 <- load_ica_combination_best_one_dataset(
    file_plan = file_plan_data1,
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data1,
    dataset_name = "data1",
    offset = 0
  )
  
  ica_comb_best_data2 <- load_ica_combination_best_one_dataset(
    file_plan = file_plan_data2,
    chlabels_by_group = chlabels_data2,
    dataset_name = "data2",
    offset = n_data1
  )
  
  ica_comb_best_all <- bind_rows(
    ica_comb_best_data1,
    ica_comb_best_data2
  )
  
  rm(ica_comb_best_data1, ica_comb_best_data2)
  gc()
  
  ica_comb_vs_full15cca <- ica_comb_best_all %>%
    left_join(
      full15cca_ref,
      by = c("dataset", "participant", "channel")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      method = "ICA",
      delta_vs_full15cca = rpeak_ica_reduced_best - rpeak_full15cca_best,
      delta_vs_full15cca_sesoi_units = delta_vs_full15cca / sesoi_subj_channel,
      delta_vs_full15cca_pct_baseline = 100 * delta_vs_full15cca / abs(rpeak_full15cca_clean1),
      performs_as_well_as_full15cca = delta_vs_full15cca <= sesoi_subj_channel,
      practically_same_as_full15cca = abs(delta_vs_full15cca) <= sesoi_subj_channel,
      better_than_full15cca_by_sesoi = delta_vs_full15cca < -sesoi_subj_channel,
      worse_than_full15cca_by_sesoi = delta_vs_full15cca > sesoi_subj_channel,
      performance_class = case_when(
        better_than_full15cca_by_sesoi ~ "better than full 15-channel CCA > SESOI",
        practically_same_as_full15cca ~ "same as full 15-channel CCA ± SESOI",
        worse_than_full15cca_by_sesoi ~ "worse than full 15-channel CCA > SESOI",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      full15cca_improvement = rpeak_full15cca_clean1 - rpeak_full15cca_best,
      ica_reduced_improvement = rpeak_full15cca_clean1 - rpeak_ica_reduced_best,
      pct_full15cca_improvement_recovered = if_else(
        full15cca_improvement > 0,
        100 * ica_reduced_improvement / full15cca_improvement,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(rpeak_ica_reduced_best),
      is.finite(rpeak_full15cca_best),
      is.finite(delta_vs_full15cca_sesoi_units)
    )
  
  rm(ica_comb_best_all)
  gc()
  saveRDS(ica_comb_vs_full15cca, ica_scored_file)
}

ica_scored_light <- ica_comb_vs_full15cca %>%
  transmute(
    dataset = as.character(dataset),
    participant = as.character(participant),
    channel = as.character(channel),
    n_ecg_leads = as.integer(n_ecg_leads),
    combination_id = as.integer(combination_id),
    ecg_leads = as.character(ecg_leads),
    combo_uid = make_combo_uid(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads),
    method = "ICA",
    rpeak_full15_clean1 = rpeak_full15cca_clean1,
    rpeak_full15_best = rpeak_full15cca_best,
    rpeak_reduced_best = rpeak_ica_reduced_best,
    clean_full15_best = clean_full15cca_best,
    clean_reduced_best = clean_ica_reduced_best,
    sesoi = sesoi_subj_channel,
    delta_vs_full15 = delta_vs_full15cca,
    loss_sesoi_units = delta_vs_full15cca_sesoi_units,
    loss_pct_baseline = delta_vs_full15cca_pct_baseline,
    performs_as_well = performs_as_well_as_full15cca,
    practically_same = practically_same_as_full15cca,
    better_by_sesoi = better_than_full15cca_by_sesoi,
    worse_by_sesoi = worse_than_full15cca_by_sesoi,
    full15_improvement = full15cca_improvement,
    reduced_improvement = ica_reduced_improvement,
    pct_full15_improvement_recovered = pct_full15cca_improvement_recovered
  )

manifest[["03_ica_scored_light"]] <- save_table(ica_scored_light, "03_ica_scored_light", csv = FALSE)

ica_scored_light %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    n_channels = n_distinct(channel),
    n_exact_combinations = n_distinct(paste(n_ecg_leads, combination_id)),
    pct_as_well = 100 * mean(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Exact-combination ranking

```{r ica-exact-summary}
make_exact_participant_summary <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, participant) %>%
    summarise(
      n_channels_available = n_distinct(channel),
      n_channels_as_well = sum(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_channels_as_well = 100 * n_channels_as_well / n_channels_available,
      median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.75),
      q90_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.90),
      median_loss_pct_baseline = median(loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90_loss_pct_baseline = safe_q(loss_pct_baseline, 0.90),
      median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered = median(pct_full15_improvement_recovered, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      participant_pass_25 = pct_channels_as_well >= 25,
      participant_pass_50 = pct_channels_as_well >= 50,
      participant_pass_60 = pct_channels_as_well >= 60,
      participant_pass_75 = pct_channels_as_well >= 75,
      participant_pass_90 = pct_channels_as_well >= 90
    )
}

make_exact_summary_from_participant <- function(participant_summary) {
  participant_summary %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_participants_total = n_distinct(participant),
      mean_pct_channels_as_well = mean(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_channels_as_well = median(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_pct_channels_as_well = safe_q(pct_channels_as_well, 0.25),
      q75_pct_channels_as_well = safe_q(pct_channels_as_well, 0.75),
      min_pct_channels_as_well = min(pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge25_channels = sum(participant_pass_25, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge50_channels = sum(participant_pass_50, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge60_channels = sum(participant_pass_60, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge75_channels = sum(participant_pass_75, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_participants_ge90_channels = sum(participant_pass_90, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_loss_sesoi_units = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q75_loss_sesoi_units = median(q75_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q90_loss_sesoi_units = median(q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      worst_participant_q90_loss_sesoi_units = max(q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_loss_pct_baseline = median(median_loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_q90_loss_pct_baseline = median(q90_loss_pct_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered = median(median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered, na.rm = TRUE),
      participants_ge50 = paste(sort(unique(participant[participant_pass_50])), collapse = ","),
      participants_ge75 = paste(sort(unique(participant[participant_pass_75])), collapse = ","),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rank_exact_summary()
}

exact_participant_summary_ica <- make_exact_participant_summary(ica_scored_light)
exact_summary_ica <- make_exact_summary_from_participant(exact_participant_summary_ica)

exact_channel_summary_ica <- ica_scored_light %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, channel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n_distinct(participant),
    pct_participants_as_well = 100 * mean(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90_loss_sesoi_units = safe_q(loss_sesoi_units, 0.90),
    median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered = median(pct_full15_improvement_recovered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

exact_summary_ica %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  slice_head(n = params$top_n_plot) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    n_ecg_leads,
    rank_within_n,
    ecg_leads,
    median_pct_channels_as_well,
    q25_pct_channels_as_well,
    n_participants_ge50_channels,
    median_loss_sesoi_units,
    median_q90_loss_sesoi_units,
    median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered
  )

manifest[["05_exact_participant_summary_ica"]] <- save_table(exact_participant_summary_ica, "05_exact_participant_summary_ica", csv = FALSE)
manifest[["06_exact_summary_ica"]] <- save_table(exact_summary_ica, "06_exact_summary_ica")
```

## Main ICA bar plot: top exact combinations

```{r ica-top-exact-barplot, fig.height=7}
plot_exact_top_ica <- exact_summary_ica %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(rank_within_n, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = params$top_n_plot) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    support_label = paste0(n_participants_ge50_channels, "/", n_participants_total),
    plot_label = paste0(ecg_leads, "___", n_ecg_leads),
    plot_rank = n_ecg_leads * 100000 + rank_within_n,
    plot_label = factor(plot_label, levels = rev(plot_label[order(plot_rank)])),
    label_y = pmin(112, pmax(median_pct_channels_as_well, q75_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE) + 4)
  )

p_ica_top_exact <- ggplot(
  plot_exact_top_ica,
```

## Participant- and EEG-channel-specific top-20% stability for ICA: within SESOI of best

For each participant × EEG-channel cell and ECG-channel count, an exact ICA combination is treated as near-best if its R-peak loss is within `r params$within_best_sesoi` SESOI unit of the best reduced ICA combination for that same cell and channel count. The bar plot then asks how often exact combinations recur in participant-specific and EEG-channel-specific top-20% pools.

```{r ica-withinbest-top20-stability, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
ica_within_best <- ica_scored_light %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, participant, channel) %>%
  mutate(
    best_loss_sesoi_units = min(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    excess_vs_best_sesoi_units = loss_sesoi_units - best_loss_sesoi_units,
    within_sesoi_of_best = excess_vs_best_sesoi_units <= params$within_best_sesoi
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

withinbest_participant_summary_ica <- ica_within_best %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, participant) %>%
  summarise(
    n_channels_available = n_distinct(channel),
    n_channels_within_best = sum(within_sesoi_of_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_channels_within_best = 100 * n_channels_within_best / n_channels_available,
    n_channels_as_well_full15cca = sum(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_channels_as_well_full15cca = 100 * n_channels_as_well_full15cca / n_channels_available,
    median_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units = median(excess_vs_best_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units = safe_q(excess_vs_best_sesoi_units, 0.90),
    median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered = median(pct_full15_improvement_recovered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

withinbest_channel_summary_ica <- ica_within_best %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid, channel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants_available = n_distinct(participant),
    n_participants_within_best = sum(within_sesoi_of_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_participants_within_best = 100 * n_participants_within_best / n_participants_available,
    n_participants_as_well_full15cca = sum(performs_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_participants_as_well_full15cca = 100 * n_participants_as_well_full15cca / n_participants_available,
    median_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units = median(excess_vs_best_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    q90_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units = safe_q(excess_vs_best_sesoi_units, 0.90),
    median_loss_sesoi_units = median(loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

participant_total <- n_distinct(withinbest_participant_summary_ica$participant)
channel_total <- n_distinct(withinbest_channel_summary_ica$channel)

withinbest_participant_ranked_ica <- withinbest_participant_summary_ica %>%
  group_by(participant, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(pct_channels_within_best),
    median_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units,
    median_loss_sesoi_units,
    ecg_leads,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    unit_rank = row_number(),
    top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
    in_top20 = unit_rank <= top20_cutoff
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

withinbest_channel_ranked_ica <- withinbest_channel_summary_ica %>%
  group_by(channel, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(pct_participants_within_best),
    median_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units,
    median_loss_sesoi_units,
    ecg_leads,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    unit_rank = row_number(),
    top20_cutoff = n_top_prop(n()),
    in_top20 = unit_rank <= top20_cutoff
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

withinbest_participant_top20_frequency_ica <- withinbest_participant_ranked_ica %>%
  filter(in_top20) %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    stability_level = "Participant-specific top 20%",
    n_units_in_top20 = n_distinct(participant),
    n_units_total = participant_total,
    pct_units_in_top20 = 100 * n_units_in_top20 / n_units_total,
    median_rank_when_top20 = median(unit_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_performance_when_top20 = median(pct_channels_within_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_excess_when_top20 = median(median_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

withinbest_channel_top20_frequency_ica <- withinbest_channel_ranked_ica %>%
  filter(in_top20) %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads, combo_uid) %>%
  summarise(
    stability_level = "EEG-channel-specific top 20%",
    n_units_in_top20 = n_distinct(channel),
    n_units_total = channel_total,
    pct_units_in_top20 = 100 * n_units_in_top20 / n_units_total,
    median_rank_when_top20 = median(unit_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_performance_when_top20 = median(pct_participants_within_best, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_excess_when_top20 = median(median_excess_vs_best_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Recurring exact subsets among top ICA sets

```{r ica-recurring-subsets, fig.height=8}
make_recurring_subsets <- function(exact_summary, top_prop = params$top_prop) {
  top_pool <- exact_summary %>%
    group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
    arrange(rank_within_n, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      n_parent_combinations_total = n(),
      parent_pool_n = n_top_prop(n_parent_combinations_total[1], top_prop),
      in_parent_top_pool = rank_within_n <= parent_pool_n
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(in_parent_top_pool)
  
  map_dfr(sort(unique(top_pool$n_ecg_leads)), function(parent_n) {
    parent_pool <- top_pool %>% filter(n_ecg_leads == parent_n)
    if (nrow(parent_pool) == 0) return(tibble())
    # Proper recurring subsets only: subset size must be smaller than parent size.
    # A 1-channel parent has no smaller non-empty subset and is therefore omitted.
    if (parent_n <= 1L) {
      return(tibble())
    }
    subset_sizes <- seq(parent_n - 1L, 1L)
    
    map_dfr(subset_sizes, function(subset_size) {
      n_top <- nrow(parent_pool)
      background_share <- choose(15 - subset_size, parent_n - subset_size) / choose(15, parent_n)
      
      parent_pool %>%
        mutate(subset = map(ecg_leads, make_subset_strings, subset_size = subset_size)) %>%
        unnest(subset) %>%
        group_by(subset) %>%
        summarise(
          parent_n_ecg_leads = parent_n,
          subset_size = subset_size,
          parent_top_pool_n = n_top,
          n_top_combinations = n_distinct(combination_id),
          top_share = n_top_combinations / n_top,
          background_share = background_share,
          enrichment_ratio = top_share / background_share,
          best_rank_containing_subset = min(rank_within_n, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_rank_containing_subset = median(rank_within_n, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_pct_channels_as_well = median(median_pct_channels_as_well, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_loss_sesoi_units = median(median_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
          median_q90_loss_sesoi_units = median(median_q90_loss_sesoi_units, na.rm = TRUE),
          example_combinations = paste(head(unique(ecg_leads), 5), collapse = " | "),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    })
  }) %>%
    arrange(parent_n_ecg_leads, desc(subset_size), desc(enrichment_ratio), desc(n_top_combinations), best_rank_containing_subset)
}

recurring_subsets_ica <- make_recurring_subsets(exact_summary_ica, top_prop = params$top_prop)
```

## Exclusive anatomical families for ICA top 20%

```{r ica-anatomical-families, fig.height=7}
make_combination_annotation_lookup_clean <- function(max_n = 5) {
  if (!exists("make_ecg15_combination_annotation_lookup")) {
    stop("make_ecg15_combination_annotation_lookup() not found. Source ecg_annotations.R first.")
  }
  suppressWarnings(make_ecg15_combination_annotation_lookup(max_n = max_n)) %>%
    mutate(
      n_ecg_leads = as.integer(n_ecg_leads),
      combination_id = as.integer(combination_id),
      ecg_leads = as.character(ecg_leads),
      combo_uid = make_combo_uid(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads),
      contains_any_V = contains_any_chest_V_location,
      n_upper_vascular = n_neck + n_supraclavicular,
      contains_upper_vascular = contains_any_neck | contains_any_supraclavicular,
      contains_any_standard_limb = n_standard_limb_electrodes > 0,
      contains_limb_axis_or_like = n_Lead_I_like_pairs > 0 | n_Lead_II_like_pairs > 0 | n_Lead_III_like_pairs > 0
    )
}

family_levels <- c(
  "all V/precordial",
  "all neck/supraclavicular",
  "all limb anchors",
  "V + limb",
  "V + neck/supraclavicular",
  "neck/supraclavicular + limb",
  "V + neck/supraclavicular + limb"
)

assign_anatomical_family_exclusive <- function(
    n_total,
    n_V,
    n_upper_vascular,
    n_standard_limb,
    contains_V,
    contains_upper_vascular,
    contains_standard_limb,
    contains_limb_axis_or_like = NULL
) {
  n_classified <- n_V + n_upper_vascular + n_standard_limb
  family_key <- paste0(
    ifelse(contains_V, "V", ""),
    ifelse(contains_upper_vascular, "U", ""),
    ifelse(contains_standard_limb, "L", "")
  )
  
  case_when(
    is.na(n_total) | n_total == 0 ~ NA_character_,
    n_classified != n_total ~ NA_character_,
    family_key == "V" ~ "all V/precordial",
    family_key == "U" ~ "all neck/supraclavicular",
    family_key == "L" ~ "all limb anchors",
    family_key == "VL" ~ "V + limb",
    family_key == "VU" ~ "V + neck/supraclavicular",
    family_key == "UL" ~ "neck/supraclavicular + limb",
    family_key == "VUL" ~ "V + neck/supraclavicular + limb",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

ecg15_combination_lookup <- make_combination_annotation_lookup_clean(max_n = 5) %>%

      n_V = n_chest_V_locations,
      n_upper_vascular = n_upper_vascular,
      n_standard_limb = n_standard_limb_electrodes,
      contains_V = contains_any_V,
      contains_upper_vascular = contains_upper_vascular,
      contains_standard_limb = contains_any_standard_limb,
      contains_limb_axis_or_like = contains_limb_axis_or_like
    ),
    anatomical_family_exclusive = factor(
      anatomical_family_exclusive,
      levels = family_levels
    )
  )
```

# 4B. ICA versus CCA comparison figures

This section loads the CCA exact-summary outputs from Part 3 when available. If those files are absent, it falls back to the scored `cca_comb_vs_full15_data1_data2.rds` object and recreates the same exact summary. The CCA reference and the ICA analysis above are therefore directly comparable: both are evaluated against full 15-channel CCA.

```{r load-cca-part3-or-recompute}
load_or_recompute_cca_summary <- function() {
  candidate_files <- c(
    file.path(datapath, "results_markdown", "part3_combinations", "04_exact_summary_all.rds"),
    file.path(datapath, "results_numbers", "06_exact_summary_ranked.rds"),
    file.path(datapath, "exact_summary_all_unbounded_sesoi.rds")
  )
  
  existing <- candidate_files[file.exists(candidate_files)]
  
  if (length(existing) > 0) {
    message("Loading CCA exact summary from: ", existing[1])
    x <- readRDS(existing[1]) %>%
      standardise_exact_summary_names() %>%
      mutate(
        method = "CCA",
        n_ecg_leads = as.integer(n_ecg_leads),
        combination_id = as.integer(combination_id),
        ecg_leads = as.character(ecg_leads),
        combo_uid = make_combo_uid(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads)
      )
    return(x)
  }
  
  message("CCA exact summary not found. Recomputing from cca_comb_vs_full15_data1_data2.rds")
  
  scored_file <- file.path(datapath, "cca_comb_vs_full15_data1_data2.rds")
  if (!file.exists(scored_file)) {
    stop("Cannot find CCA scored file: ", scored_file)
  }
  
  cca_raw <- readRDS(scored_file)
  
  cca_light <- cca_raw %>%
    filter(n_ecg_leads <= 5) %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = as.character(dataset),
      participant = as.character(participant),
      channel = as.character(channel),
      n_ecg_leads = as.integer(n_ecg_leads),
      combination_id = as.integer(combination_id),
      ecg_leads = as.character(ecg_leads),
      combo_uid = make_combo_uid(n_ecg_leads, combination_id, ecg_leads),
      method = "CCA",
      rpeak_full15_clean1,
      rpeak_full15_best,
      rpeak_reduced_best,
      clean_full15_best,
      clean_reduced_best,
      sesoi = sesoi_subj_channel,
      delta_vs_full15 = delta_vs_full15,
      loss_sesoi_units = delta_vs_full15_sesoi_units,
      loss_pct_baseline = delta_vs_full15_pct_baseline,
      performs_as_well = performs_as_well_as_full15,
      practically_same = practically_same_as_full15,
      better_by_sesoi = better_than_full15_by_sesoi,
      worse_by_sesoi = worse_than_full15_by_sesoi,
      full15_improvement,
      reduced_improvement = rpeak_full15_clean1 - rpeak_reduced_best,
      pct_full15_improvement_recovered
    )
  
  cca_part <- make_exact_participant_summary(cca_light)
  make_exact_summary_from_participant(cca_part) %>%
    mutate(method = "CCA")
}

exact_summary_cca <- load_or_recompute_cca_summary() %>%
```

```{r cca-top-candidates-under-ica}
    ) %>%
    select(n_ecg_leads, plot_label, CCA = cca_median_pct_channels_as_well, ICA = ica_median_pct_channels_as_well) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(CCA, ICA), names_to = "method", values_to = "median_pct_channels_as_well") %>%
    mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c("ICA", "CCA"))),
  aes(x = plot_label, y = median_pct_channels_as_well, fill = method)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ n_ecg_leads, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "CCA-selected exact combination",
    y = "Median % EEG channels as good as full 15-channel CCA",
    fill = "Evaluation method",
    title = "Do the top CCA-selected ECG combinations also work under ICA?",
    subtitle = "Same exact ECG-channel sets are evaluated with ICA and CCA against the full 15-channel CCA reference"
  ) +
  theme_pub_small

p_cca_top_under_ica
save_plot(p_cca_top_under_ica, "16_cca_top_candidates_evaluated_under_ica", width = 11, height = 7)
manifest[["27_cca_top_under_ica"]] <- save_table(cca_top_under_ica, "27_cca_top_under_ica")
```

# Text-ready summary stubs

```{r text-stubs}
best_ica_per_n_text <- exact_summary_ica %>%
  group_by(n_ecg_leads) %>%
  arrange(rank_within_n, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sentence = paste0(
      "For ", n_ecg_leads, " ECG channel(s), the best ICA combination relative to the full 15-channel CCA reference was ",
      ecg_leads, ", with median participant-level EEG-channel coverage of ",
      fmt_pct(median_pct_channels_as_well), ", ",
      n_participants_ge50_channels, "/", n_participants_total,
      " participants reaching ≥50% EEG-channel coverage, median loss of ",
      fmt_num(median_loss_sesoi_units, 2), " SESOI units, and median recovery of ",
      fmt_pct(median_pct_full15_improvement_recovered), " of the full 15-channel CCA improvement."
    )
  ) %>%
  select(n_ecg_leads, ecg_leads, sentence)

withinbest_ica_text <- withinbest_top20_frequency_ica %>%
  group_by(stability_level, n_ecg_leads) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sentence = paste0(
      "For ", n_ecg_leads, " ECG channel(s), the most stable ICA combination in the ",
      stability_level, " analysis was ", ecg_leads, ", appearing in ",
      n_units_in_top20, "/", n_units_total, " unit-specific top-20% pools."
    )
  ) %>%
  select(stability_level, n_ecg_leads, ecg_leads, sentence)

kable_clean(best_ica_per_n_text)
kable_clean(withinbest_ica_text)

manifest[["28_best_ica_per_n_text"]] <- save_table(best_ica_per_n_text, "28_best_ica_per_n_text")
manifest[["29_withinbest_ica_text"]] <- save_table(withinbest_ica_text, "29_withinbest_ica_text")
```

# Save manifest

```{r save-manifest}
manifest_df <- bind_rows(manifest)
manifest_public <- manifest_df %>%
  mutate(
    rds = if_else(is.na(rds), NA_character_, basename(rds)),
    csv = if_else(is.na(csv), NA_character_, basename(csv))
  )

saveRDS(manifest_public, file.path(outpath, "99_manifest.rds"))
utils::write.csv(manifest_public, file.path(outpath, "99_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Manifest saved as 99_manifest.rds and 99_manifest.csv.\n")

if (isTRUE(params$show_manifest)) {
  kable_clean(manifest_public)
}
```
